newsitem.title: INDIA: India tribal militants kill five extremist rivals.
newsitem.headline: India tribal militants kill five extremist rivals.

text.p: India's Bodo militants killed five supporters of rival tribal extremists demanding a separate nation in the northeast state of Assam, police said on Monday.

The rebels, armed with assault weapons, attacked a vehicle carrying Golapi Basumatary, general secretary of the Bodo Women Justice Forum (BWJF) and four others at Kathalbari 30 km (18 miles) from the Bhutan border on Sunday, police said.
Bodos are demanding a homeland within India.
BWJF is an activist group believed to be allied to Bodo separatists.
In the last one month, more than 50 Bodo political and student leaders have been killed in fratricidal violence between militant Bodos and their rivals, police said.
Army and paramilitary troops have launched a massive search operation in the area to hunt for militants, they said.
